description: Create js/shared.js and js/flash.js, js/quiz.js, js/write.js, js/stats.js, js/favorites.js, js/custom.js, js/settings.js — all the new split JS modules extracted from app.js. These are the core logic files that the new HTML pages will load. This FEAT does NOT create the new HTML pages yet (FEAT-002 does that). It also applies bug fixes: auto-shuffle on deck load, level init value, and favorite fallback level.
steps:
Create js/shared.js. This is the most critical file. It must:
  - Declare the $ helper: const $ = id => document.getElementById(id)
  - Declare all shared state globals at top: let level = 'HSK 1' (IMPORTANT: space, not 'HSK1'), deck = [], fcIdx = 0, qScore = 0, qTotal = 0, wIdx = 0, wChars = []; const userId = 'default_user';
  - let favorites = (window.WQStorage && WQStorage.getFavorites()) || JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('wq_favorites')) || [];
  - let autoplayInterval = null, autoplayRunning = false, autoplayTimer = null;
  - let quizMode = localStorage.getItem('wq_quiz_mode') || 'hanzi-to-mean';
  - let quizPool = [], quizAskedWords = [];
  - Copy showToast() from app.js lines 1-27
  - Copy window.wqPopup object from app.js lines 28-120
  - Copy deduplicateWords() from app.js
  - Copy shuffle() from app.js
  - Copy speak()/loadVoices() from app.js
  - Copy Particle canvas animation (resizeCanvas, Particle class, initParticles, animateParticles) from app.js
  - Copy theme init block (themeBtn logic) from app.js — use the settingsThemeBtn since themeBtn is hidden
  - Copy loadDataFromAPI() and the setTimeout API init block from app.js
  - Copy initUIWithData(), updateFavOptionText(), buildRanges(), applyRange() from app.js
    - BUG FIX IN applyRange(): after 'deck = deduplicateWords(deck);' add 'shuffle(deck);' before 'fcIdx=0;'
  - Copy saveProgress() and loadProgress() from app.js
  - Copy removePinyinTones() from app.js
  - Copy search box logic (searchInput/searchSuggestions event handlers) from app.js
  - REWRITE navigateToWord(w) for multi-page: save target to localStorage ('wq_search_target'), then window.location.href = 'flash.html'
  - Copy updateHomeDashboard() and renderHomeHskGrid() from the sidebar IIFE in app.js
  - Write initSidebarNavigation(): instead of toggling sections, use current page filename to set active menu item. E.g. const page = location.pathname.split('/').pop() || 'index.html'; set active on the menu item whose href matches the page. Sidebar toggle (hamburger) and outside-click-close still apply.
  - Copy openProfileBtn event setup from the sidebar IIFE DOMContentLoaded block
  - Set window.AppState = { get level(){return level}, get deck(){return deck}, get fcIdx(){return fcIdx}, ... } or simply document that state is accessed via globals
  - Set window.WQSyncData = function() { favorites = (WQStorage && WQStorage.getFavorites()) || ...; updateFavOptionText(); }
  - DOMContentLoaded handler: call initSidebarNavigation(); setup openProfileBtn; set learnSelectorsWrapper display based on page (visible on flash.html/quiz.html/write.html, hidden otherwise); call initUIWithData() if DATA available; call loadProgress(); if on index.html, setTimeout(updateHomeDashboard, 100)

Create js/flash.js. Must:
  - Use globals from shared.js (level, deck, fcIdx, favorites, etc.)
  - Copy recordLearnedWord() from app.js
  - Copy renderFlash() from app.js
  - Copy renderFavIcon() from app.js
  - Copy toggleFavorite() from app.js
    - BUG FIX: change the fallback '|| \'HSK1\'' to '|| \'HSK 1\'' to match DATA keys
  - Copy card click/flip handler, parallax mousemove/mouseleave from app.js
  - Copy fcNext.onclick, fcPrev.onclick, fcAudio.onclick, fcFav.onclick from app.js
  - Copy swipe gesture (touchstart/touchend/handleSwipe) from app.js
  - Copy startAutoplay(), stopAutoplay(), runAutoplayCycle() from app.js
  - Copy autoplayBtn.onclick from app.js
  - Copy keyboard handler (ArrowRight/ArrowLeft/Space) from app.js
  - Copy checkFlashcardComplete() from the custom IIFE in app.js (reads sessionStorage wq_study_mode)
  - Export: window.checkFlashcardComplete = checkFlashcardComplete
  - DOMContentLoaded: check localStorage 'wq_pending_deck' — if set, parse it, set level/deck/fcIdx and clear the key, then renderFlash(); also check 'wq_pending_level' — if set, set levelSel.value and dispatch change event. Then call renderFlash(), renderWriterList() if exists, renderWriter() if exists, newQuiz() if exists. Call stopAutoplay on page unload.

Create js/quiz.js. Must:
  - Use globals from shared.js
  - Copy newQuiz() from app.js
  - Copy recordSrsAnswer() from app.js
  - Copy answer() from app.js
  - Copy quiz mode button event bindings from app.js
  - Restore saved quizMode: const savedBtn = document.querySelector('.quiz-mode-btn[data-mode="'+quizMode+'"]'); if (savedBtn) { ... }
  - Copy qNext.onclick = newQuiz and qAudio.onclick from app.js
  - Copy renderQuizHskGrid(), renderQuizCustomDecks() from the QUIZ DECK SELECTION IIFE in app.js
  - Copy startQuizWithDeck(), backToQuizSelection() from the QUIZ DECK SELECTION IIFE in app.js
  - Export: window.startQuizWithDeck = startQuizWithDeck
  - DOMContentLoaded: render HSK grid + custom decks; bind qBackBtn.onclick = backToQuizSelection; check localStorage 'wq_pending_deck' — if present and mode is 'quiz', parse it, call startQuizWithDeck(deck.name, deck.words), clear the key

Create js/write.js. Must:
  - Use globals from shared.js
  - Copy renderWriterList() from app.js
  - Copy renderWriter() from app.js
  - Copy buildWriter() from app.js
  - Copy wAnimate.onclick, wQuiz.onclick, wAudio.onclick from app.js
  - DOMContentLoaded: call renderWriterList() and renderWriter()

Create js/stats.js. Must:
  - Copy renderStatsSection() from the sidebar IIFE in app.js
  - DOMContentLoaded: call renderStatsSection()

Create js/favorites.js. Must:
  - Copy renderFavModalList() from app.js. Target element is #favModalList (same ID, exists in favorites.html's flat section)
  - Remove the overlay show/hide logic (no modal to open/close — it's a full page now)
  - DOMContentLoaded: call renderFavModalList()

Create js/custom.js. Must:
  - Copy the entire CUSTOM DECK FEATURE IIFE from app.js, adapting:
    - startStudySession(): REPLACE the section-navigation code with localStorage + window.location.href:
      * mode 'flashcard': localStorage.setItem('wq_pending_deck', JSON.stringify({name, words})); localStorage.setItem('wq_pending_mode', 'flashcard'); window.location.href = 'flash.html';
      * mode 'quiz': same but window.location.href = 'quiz.html';
      * mode 'both': localStorage.setItem('wq_pending_deck', ...) + localStorage.setItem('wq_pending_mode', 'both') + window.location.href = 'flash.html';
    - Remove navigateToQuizAndStart() (no longer needed — quiz.html handles pending deck)
    - checkFlashcardComplete() still uses sessionStorage as before (flash.js handles it)
    - studyCustomDeck() shows modal same as before
    - All other logic (search, add, save, import JSON, duplicate modal) unchanged
  - DOMContentLoaded: initCustomDeckEvents(); setTimeout(async () => { await loadCustomHistory(); renderCustomHistory(); }, 600)
  - Export: window.checkFlashcardComplete = checkFlashcardComplete (for compatibility)

Create js/settings.js. Must:
  - Copy updateSettingsUI() from the sidebar IIFE in app.js
  - Copy initSettingsEvents() from the sidebar IIFE in app.js
    - Theme toggle: works the same (toggles document.documentElement.classList)
    - Autoplay speed: save to localStorage('wq_autoplay_speed', value) instead of syncing to #autoplaySpeed DOM (which is on flash.html). flash.js reads this on load.
    - Reset progress: same logic but after reset navigate to index.html instead of triggering sidebar menu click
  - DOMContentLoaded: updateSettingsUI(); initSettingsEvents()
acceptance_criteria: c:\Users\DAnnotator2\Khanh\hanyu\js\ directory exists with all 8 files: shared.js, flash.js, quiz.js, write.js, stats.js, favorites.js, custom.js, settings.js
No syntax errors in any of the 8 files (can be checked by loading in browser or node --check)
All global state variables (level, deck, fcIdx, favorites, etc.) are declared in shared.js and NOT re-declared in page-specific JS files
applyRange() in shared.js calls shuffle(deck) after deduplicateWords(deck)
level is initialized as 'HSK 1' (with space) in shared.js
toggleFavorite() in flash.js uses '|| \'HSK 1\'' as fallback (not 'HSK1')
startStudySession() in custom.js uses window.location.href to navigate, not direct DOM manipulation
No import/export keywords anywhere in the js/ files
verification: Check syntax: in browser DevTools, load any page and confirm js/shared.js, js/flash.js etc. load with no syntax errors in console
Grep for 'shuffle(deck)' in js/shared.js inside applyRange() — should appear after deduplicateWords
Grep for 'window.location.href' in js/custom.js inside startStudySession
